inference_compute_disclosure.candidate_gsm8k: one up-to-192-token expression-planning call, then a restricted local arithmetic evaluator; direct 64-token fallback if parsing fails
inference_compute_disclosure.candidate_tools: deterministic local solver; no model call when recognized

evaluation_policy: Candidate routing was locked before benchmark-100-v5 was built. V5 excludes every prompt in v3 and v4.
rewrite_evidence: Separate official-Wikipedia-API Apollo task: 18/59 untouched versus 29/59 temporary rank-8 rewrite, held-out wording and retrieval disabled at evaluation. This is narrow fact-retention evidence and did not cause the 75/100 benchmark score.
claim_limit: This suite proves a task-scoped score improvement and a win over one 7.6B reference. It does not prove universal model equivalence, 10B/20B equivalence, or a general intelligence multiplier.
